P0-SECRETS.label: REAL
P0-SECRETS.title: No credentials, keys or tokens anywhere in the repository (secret scan over the whole tree and history)

P1-DOCS.label: REAL
P1-DOCS.title: DECISIONS.md has architecture, threat model, guardrail spec, PCB spec and recorded advisor/reviewer advice

P1-HARNESS.label: REAL
P1-HARNESS.title: The acceptance checker treats skip/missing as FAIL and detects stale PASS; continuity files exist

P1-UNIT.label: SIMULATED
P1-UNIT.title: First unit through the full cycle: signed approval tokens (guardrail 3) with an evaluator report

P2-FLEET.label: EMULATED
P2-FLEET.title: Pairing, per-write approval, auto-setup and undo between two or more isolated VMs/containers

P2-GATE.label: SIMULATED
P2-GATE.title: Policy gate runs writes only with a valid single-use token bound to the exact action; undo recorded first

P2-GUARDRAILS.label: SIMULATED
P2-GUARDRAILS.title: Scripted guardrail battery (all ten rules of MISSION 4.1) gives zero violations

P2-LOG.label: SIMULATED
P2-LOG.title: Append-only hash-chained log; any edit, rewrite, truncation or reorder is detected against a known head; a broken log is never extended (process separation from the model is P2-GUARDRAILS)

P2-MEMORY.label: SIMULATED
P2-MEMORY.title: Portable memory in an open format round-trips and is encrypted at rest

P2-MODEL.label: EMULATED
P2-MODEL.title: The local model answers from the read-only medium with nothing installed on the host

P2-PAIRING.label: SIMULATED
P2-PAIRING.title: The gate accepts only the paired key_id; MAS chat_choice approvals are absent from the device build; the host owner's launch is the session consent (D-021)

P2-PORTABLE.label: EMULATED
P2-PORTABLE.title: One-command launch from a read-only medium in a clean VM/container; profiler picks compute mode

P2-ZEROTRACE.label: EMULATED
P2-ZEROTRACE.title: Nothing installed after unplug (no service, driver, autostart, PATH change or file outside the declared temp dir); OS residue only from the enumerated allowlist (D-010 three-arm diff)

P3-INSPECT.label: SIMULATED
P3-INSPECT.title: Inventory precision and recall against fixtures with known truth meet thresholds

P3-NOCREDS.label: SIMULATED
P3-NOCREDS.title: Inspection never collects credentials; planted secrets never reach the report or the model context

P3-READONLY.label: EMULATED
P3-READONLY.title: Inspection makes zero writes (diff and read-only mount) and never touches the network

P3-REPORT.label: SIMULATED
P3-REPORT.title: The inspection report is readable by the owner and consumable by the agent (schema-checked)

P4-FW-EMU.label: EMULATED
P4-FW-EMU.title: Same firmware runs in QEMU (mps2-an505, Cortex-M33) with transcripts identical to the host build; button is the only approval path

P4-FW-HOST.label: SIMULATED
P4-FW-HOST.title: Firmware core (host build, HAL mocks) rejects replayed, altered and expired approvals; signs only after a press

P4-FW-RENODE.label: EMULATED
P4-FW-RENODE.title: Same firmware runs in Renode with transcripts identical to the host build and QEMU

P4-SECBOOT.label: DESIGN-ONLY
P4-SECBOOT.title: Secure boot and lock design documented (RDP, TrustZone option bytes, key identity) and checked against the firmware's assumptions

P5-ENCLOSURE.label: DESIGN-ONLY

P5-PCB.label: DESIGN-ONLY

P6-PAPER.label: REAL
